articles.headline: Zero to hero: Socceroos' Robertson scores stunning match-winner after own goal

keyEvents.text: Second Half begins Norwich City 0, Cardiff City 0.
Kenny McLean (Norwich City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.

Goal! Norwich City 0, Cardiff City 1. Yousef Salech (Cardiff City) left footed shot from the right side of the six yard box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Alex Robertson with a cross following a set piece situation.
Substitution, Norwich City. Sam Field replaces Kenny McLean.
Goal! Norwich City 1, Cardiff City 1. Paris Maghoma (Norwich City) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Anthony Musaba.
Penalty saved. Mathias Kvistgaarden (Norwich City) right footed shot saved in the bottom left corner by Nathan Trott (Cardiff City).
Goal! Norwich City 2, Cardiff City 1. Mathias Kvistgaarden (Norwich City) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal following a set piece situation.
Substitution, Norwich City. Jovon Makama replaces Paris Maghoma.
Substitution, Norwich City. Lucien Mahovo replaces Anthony Musaba.
Substitution, Norwich City. Oscar Schwartau replaces Andre Brooks.
